Name: Skim Wounds
Description: You transform your right arm into a long, sharp and green blade. Make a melee attack against one creature within 5 feet of you. If it hits, you deal 2d12 piercing damage and the creature suffers 2 counts of Bleed. Until the start of your next turn, any creature has disadvantage on Wisdom (Medicine) ability checks made to stop the Bleeding of target creature.
At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d12 and they suffer an additional count of Bleed for each slot level above 2nd.
